text: Investigating the required-flag bug in src/click/core.py now. ETA ~15 min.
Got it — bug #2 (echo with no streams, touching _compat.py/_termui_impl.py/utils.py) is now being worked on in parallel. ETA ~20 min.
Bug #3 (envvar + flag_value in src/click/core.py) is being investigated now. ETA ~18 min.
Bug #4 (argument decorator used multiple times must preserve cls, src/click/decorators.py) is being fixed now. ETA ~15 min.
Bug #5 (symlink resolution in src/click/types.py) is being fixed now. ETA ~15 min.

Bug #1 fixed: in Option.__init__ (src/click/core.py:2519) an implicit `default = False` was installed for flag options even when `required=True`, so the required check never fired. Now the implicit default is only set when `not self.required`. Verified: missing required flag → exit code 2 with "Error: Missing option '--flag'."; full suite 488 passed / 21 skipped / 1 xfailed, same as baseline.

Bug #4 fixed: in src/click/decorators.py `argument()`, the inner decorator did `attrs.pop("cls", Argument)`, which destructively removed `cls` from the shared closure dict — so a decorator applied more than once fell back to the base `Argument`. Now it copies attrs first (matching the existing fix in `option()`). Verified with a repro; full suite 488 passed / 21 skipped / 1 xfailed, unchanged.

Bug #5 fixed: in src/click/types.py `Path.convert`, `resolve_path=True` first called `os.readlink(rv)` and then `os.path.realpath(rv)`. `os.readlink` returns the raw (possibly relative) link target, which `realpath` then resolved against the CWD instead of the link's directory — so relative symlinks resolved to the wrong path (and `exists=True` raised a spurious "does not exist"). Removed the readlink step; `os.path.realpath` already makes the path absolute and resolves symlinks correctly. Verified with a symlink repro; full suite 488 passed / 21 skipped / 1 xfailed, unchanged.
Bug #6 (flag value from default_map, src/click/core.py) is being fixed now. ETA ~12 min.
